contributions.claim: Overnight hack heated supermarket refrigeration in hundreds of French shops, some to 50C, causing food losses; prosecutor also reports fires.
contributions.attribution: NOS/BBC reporting; Paris prosecutor via Guardian
contributions.uncertainty: Estimated millions in losses; companies have not supplied amounts in NOS.

contributions.claim: NOS reports compromised outdated software in Danish-made cooling equipment and cybersecurity agency investigating extent.
Ahold Delhaize digital security incident disrupted AH distribution, deliveries, discounts and labels, also affecting Etos, Gall & Gall and Belgian Delhaize.
contributions.uncertainty: Systems preventively switched off; intrusion and cause not confirmed.

contributions.claim: Was the AH incident caused by malicious intrusion or precautionary closure after discovering a vulnerability?
contributions.uncertainty: Expert suspicions are hypotheses, not established attack or data theft.

relations.reason: Concurrent retail cyber incidents have different mechanisms; Ahold spokesperson says no reason to see a link.

delta_expectations.reason: Two distinct incidents and unresolved AH cause must remain separate.
Mechanism and investigation add material detail.

questions.claim: What caused AH's incident, was there intrusion or data compromise, and how long will disruption last?

ambiguity_notes: Guardian fears Dutch chains affected do not establish linkage. Expert criminal-group/state-actor speculation cannot establish perpetrators or stolen data. AH internal consequence updates are one incident, not independent attacks.

decisions.decision: Require French refrigeration attack; allow mechanism detail without duplicate mandatory unit.
decisions.reason: O021/O023 support heating, losses and prosecutor-reported fires.

decisions.decision: Require separate Ahold disruption and explicit uncertainty over cause.
decisions.reason: Shutdown/consequences reported; expert intrusion theories and precautionary vulnerability explanation remain hypotheses.

decisions.decision: Prohibit unsupported same-story inference for the two incidents.
decisions.reason: Different mechanisms and company statement provide no supported common event/cause. This is an evidence boundary, not proof a link is impossible.

reference_scope: frozen source-only DEVELOPMENT reference; not truth, holdout or reliability evidence
